seo.title: Our Essence & Conscious Philosophy
seo.description: Our essence, conscious beauty philosophy and Secretos del Agua biodynamic cosmetics at Salón Pilar Palomares in Málaga.

hero.text: A new paradigm of beauty that puts health, wellbeing and respect for nature's rhythms first.
hero.imgAlt: Our essence: a biodynamic, conscious beauty philosophy at Salón Pilar Palomares, Torre de Benagalbón, Axarquía (Málaga)

historia.imgAlt: Pilar Palomares with her organic hairdressing team in Torre de Benagalbón
historia.quote: "Pilar Palomares is a hairdresser and beautician by vocation. A career spanning more than 30 years, defined by perseverance, excellence and an unwavering commitment to wellbeing."
historia.p1: With the experience of having founded six salons and the trust of thousands of clients, Pilar has evolved her mastery towards a higher concept: conscious beauty. Her pursuit of perfection led her to leave the conventional behind and embrace the organic.
historia.p2: Salón Pilar Palomares is the result of that evolution. A space of global awareness where every product is organic and of biological origin. Here, hair and skin care is understood as a true system of health — free of aggression and in complete harmony with nature.

despertar.imgAlt: The beauty of awakening - Conscious connection at Salón Pilar Palomares
despertar.quote: "True beauty begins the moment you decide to be yourself."
despertar.text: Through organic clays and treatments, this philosophy comes to life. Today, with the same passion and smile as on day one, Pilar opens the doors to her dream come true: a sanctuary where beauty is, above all, respect and health.
despertar.item1Text: We seek to inspire a shift towards a healthier, more conscious world through every ritual.
despertar.item2Text: We prioritise relaxation and holistic care with personalised facial and body biotherapies.
despertar.img2Alt: Application of clay and organic treatments to the hair with natural and botanical ingredients

refugio.card1Text: A benchmark for sustainable beauty in Rincón de la Victoria, Añoreta and across the Axarquía.
refugio.card1Alt: A sustainable beauty experience in Torre de Benagalbón
refugio.card2Text: "Nurturing your inner light is a way of illuminating those around you. By looking within, we connect with the flame inside".
refugio.card2Alt: An experience of emotional wellbeing and inner light
refugio.card3Text: A profound fusion where hair and skin care become rituals of higher consciousness for your holistic health.
refugio.card3Alt: Conscious wellbeing: hair and skin health rituals in the Axarquía, Málaga

metodo.imgAlt: Biodynamic Agriculture - The biodynamic method and botanical actives
metodo.textAfter: , we follow the principles of biodynamic agriculture to offer you effective, healthy and biodegradable formulas that respect the natural cycles of the earth and the cosmos.
metodo.item1Text: High-quality, pesticide-free ingredients that follow the cycles of the astronomical calendar for superior efficacy.
metodo.item2Text: We use pure spring water from the Pyrenees, rich in energy and information, as the perfect vehicle to carry our botanical actives.

rituales.text: Our self-care rituals are a liberating practice for consciously reconnecting with yourself. Time devoted to nurturing the spirit through the body.
rituales.imgAlt: Pinda ritual - A sensory experience at Salón Pilar Palomares
rituales.card1Text: Biodynamic hydration and deep detox treatments that respect your health.
rituales.card2Text: Ancestral techniques with exclusive clays and oils, designed to make you shine with health.
rituales.card3Text: Wellbeing rituals that restore your body's harmony and lift your spirit.

cosmos.imgAlt: Rhythms of the Moon and the Earth - In sync with the cosmos
cosmos.card1Text: We follow the Biodynamic Calendar to choose the most favourable moment for your haircut or to enhance the results of your colour.
cosmos.card2Text: Our rituals adapt to the seasons of the year, respecting what your skin and hair need at every moment of natural transition.
cosmos.text: Discover our method for enhancing your beauty through astronomical rhythms and plan your next visit at the optimal moment.
